details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept: a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") sends a host-metadata beacon at install time. beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON body containing the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), the npm user the publisher and protocol to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc with an "X-Beacon-Package: template-projection-map" header. The package's main export, index.js, is a catch-all Proxy that returns a no-op stand-in for any property or call, so that a consumer's build completes instead of crashing while the beacon is still delivered. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are collected or transmitted.
